howTo.title: Simple, step by step
howTo.subtitle: Ordering takes just a few minutes — we take care of the rest.
howTo.guideSubtitle: Tap or hover over a point to see where and how to measure.
howTo.tips: Tip: measure over thin clothing; keep the tape snug but not tight.

points.name: Bust
points.text: Measure around the fullest part of the bust, keeping the tape horizontal across the back.

points.name: Waist
points.text: Measure at the narrowest part of the waist, just above the navel.

points.name: Hips
points.text: Measure around the widest part of the hips, feet together.

points.name: Shoulder width
points.text: From one shoulder edge to the other, across the back.

points.name: Sleeve length
points.text: From the shoulder edge to the wrist, arm slightly bent.

points.name: Garment length
points.text: From the highest point of the shoulder to the desired length.

points.name: Height
points.text: Barefoot, against a wall, from head to floor.
